question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**inscribed.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will imply how the figures were engraved on the clay tablets.**
 
• **Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use is "inscribed."**(उत्कीर्ण)
 
• "Inscribed" means to write or engrave
